name: translate-this
title: TranslateThis
description: Translate text with Google Translate or DeepL: language sets, translation to many languages at once, translate & copy or paste, text-to-speech
author: woysful

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate
commands.subtitle: TranslateThis
commands.description: Translate text in a form: provider, source and target languages, DeepL formality and language swap

commands.name: translate-list
commands.title: Translate List
commands.subtitle: TranslateThis
commands.description: Translate text with the selected language set: to several languages at once, and in both directions with one target language

commands.name: instant-translate-copy
commands.title: Translate & Copy
commands.subtitle: TranslateThis
commands.description: Translate the text typed after the command (or the clipboard text, see Clipboard Fallback) and copy the translation

commands.name: instant-translate-paste
commands.title: Translate & Paste
commands.subtitle: TranslateThis
commands.description: Translate the text typed after the command (or the clipboard text, see Clipboard Fallback) and paste the translation into the previous window

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: Translation service used by default. Views can switch it with Ctrl+Shift+P; the switch lasts until this preference is changed

preferences.name: deeplApiKey
preferences.title: DeepL API Key
preferences.description: Needed for DeepL. Free keys (ending in :fx) and Pro keys both work. Get one at deepl.com/pro-api

preferences.name: formality
preferences.title: DeepL Formality
preferences.description: Default formality for DeepL translations. Languages without formality ignore it

preferences.name: langFrom
preferences.title: Translate From
preferences.description: Source language of the default language set

preferences.name: lang2
preferences.title: Secondary Language
preferences.description: Used when the text is already in the primary language

preferences.name: autoInput
preferences.title: Autofill Input
preferences.label: Fill the input with the clipboard text
preferences.description: Translate and Translate List start with the text from the clipboard

preferences.name: instantClipboard
preferences.title: Clipboard Fallback
preferences.label: Translate the clipboard when no text is typed
preferences.description: Translate & Copy and Translate & Paste translate the clipboard text when nothing is typed after the command. When off, only the typed text is translated

preferences.name: translateOnType
preferences.title: Translate as You Type
preferences.label: Translate while typing
preferences.description: When off, Translate and Translate List translate only when you run the Translate action (Ctrl+Enter in Translate, Enter in Translate List). Saves API characters

preferences.name: showPronunciation
preferences.title: Pronunciation
preferences.label: Show romanization of translations
preferences.description: Latin transcription from Google Translate, e.g. "Vsem privet" under "Всем привет"

preferences.name: listLayout
preferences.title: Translate List Layout
preferences.description: Compact: one row per translation with the pronunciation on its own row, Ctrl+F shows the details. Details: the side panel with the full text and languages is open from the start

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Default Action
preferences.description: What Enter does with a translation

preferences.name: prioritizeCrossLanguage
preferences.title: Result Ordering
preferences.label: Prioritize cross-language translations
preferences.description: When the text is already in one of the target languages, move that result (e.g. English → English) to the bottom

preferences.name: ttsPlayer
preferences.title: Text-to-Speech Player
preferences.description: Command that plays an MP3 file, {file} is replaced with its path. Empty means the first of mpv, ffplay, mpg123, pw-play, cvlc

preferences.name: proxy
preferences.title: HTTP Proxy URL
preferences.description: Proxy for all requests, e.g. http://proxy.example.com:8080
